name: Moon Pebble
note: Smooth, pale and a little warm.

name: Brass Acorn
note: It rattles. Something is inside.

name: Paper Kite
note: Snagged in the hedge at the crossroads.

name: Lake Bell
note: Rings on its own when the water is still.

name: Meadow Heart Seed
note: One more heart.

name: Reed Flute
note: Three notes. All of them cheerful.

name: Rift Lantern
note: Left burning on the far bank.

name: Cloud Feather
note: Lighter than it looks.

name: Clover Pin
note: Four leaves, slightly bent.

name: Echo Shell
note: Hold it close. The hollow hums back.

name: Glow Moth Jar
note: The moths left. The glow stayed.

name: Dash Core
note: Dash in a burst. A dash crosses rifts and slips past shots.

name: Hollow Heart Seed
note: One more heart.

name: Blind Fish Charm
note: Carved from river stone.

name: Keep Heart Seed
note: One more heart.

name: Rusty Key
note: It fits no lock you have found.

name: Thorn Crown
note: Woven, not forged.

name: Cracked Shield
note: It stopped one last hit.

name: Warden Bell
note: Its ring calms the brambles.

name: Star Map Scrap
note: A corner of a bigger sky. More to come.
